explanation: The value is high (9-10) only at D1, and only when the previous trial was a choice of a1 that went rare to S2 and was rewarded; this is strongest early in the episode (roughly trials 1-35) and right after several a1-to-S2 rare trials, while the same event late in the episode can stay at 0. Everywhere else it is 0: every GO and D2 step, and any D1 after a common transition, after an unrewarded trial, or after a2 went rare to S1 (at most 1 at D1 after an unrewarded a1-to-S2 rare trial).
